dohot pidong na sai habang na martonga langitan,
Debata do umbotosa, namananda nang goarna,
ai luhut natinompaNa, disarihon Debata.
Piga ma angka dakdanak ditoru ni langit i,
na hisar na las rohana dungo dimanogot i?
Debata parasiroha, sumarihon saluhutna,
ho tongtong parmuduonNa, pos roham di Debata

r: Pi-ga ma to-rop ni i-han, na di laut na bi-da-ngan,
do-hot pi-dong na sai ha-bang na mar-to-nga la-ngit-an,
De-ba-ta do um-bo-to-sa, na-ma-nan-da nang go-ar-na, ai lu-hut na-ti-nom-pa-Na, di-sa-ri-hon De-ba-ta.
Pi-ga ma ang-ka dak-da-nak di-to-ru ni la-ngit i,
na hi-sar na las ro-ha-na du-ngo di-ma-no-got i?
De-ba-ta par-a-si-ro-ha, su-ma-ri-hon sa-lu-hut-na, ho tong-tong par-mu-du-on-Na, pos ro-ham di De-ba-ta
